'''Echani accuracy gloves''' were gloves that helped the wearer fight unarmed against opponents wielding [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]].

==Description==
[[Echani/Legends|Echani]] accuracy [[Glove/Legends|gloves]]<ref name="kotor2" /> were designed to help an individual using the ancient Echani techniques in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] remain competitive against the most advanced melee weapons of the era. The gloves were a [[Color/Legends|silvery pink]] color on the outside and dark brown on the inside.<ref name="kotor2" />

==History==
Although they were quite rare, Echani accuracy gloves were in use soon after the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="kotor2" /> during a series of conflicts known as the [[Dark Wars]]<ref name="kotorcg" /> which were fought between the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="kotor2" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> Echani accuracy gloves could sell for around 16,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Echani accuracy gloves first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Obsidian Entertainment]]. In ''The Sith Lords'', the gloves were a rare item that could be found in randomly determined locations throughout the game, and because of this, the player was not guaranteed to find them every time through the game. The gloves granted a large damage bonus to unarmed attacks, and a small bonus to both dexterity and the unarmed attack modifier.<ref name="kotor2" /> They also received an entry in [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]] by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="kotor2g">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
